name: wayfinder
description: Personal Markdown task tracker and project memory for Claude Code: MCP tools, session context and a local web board.

home.title: Data folder
home.description: Folder that holds the Wayfinder data repository (run "wayfinder init" once). Default: ~/.wayfinder

capturesDir.title: Screenshots folder
capturesDir.description: Optional folder from which screenshots may be attached, besides the current repository.

webHost.title: Web address for other devices
webHost.description: Optional. This PC's IP on your network or on Tailscale (a literal IP such as 192.168.1.20), used when you ask Claude "abre Wayfinder". Empty or not a valid IP: the web is only available on this PC.

language.title: Language / Idioma
language.description: Language for Wayfinder messages, hooks and web board (es = español, en = English).
